text: Blocking. Candidate pairs formed within organization (ein) across different tax years. Blocks tiny (median 9 records per org-year), every cross-year pair within org compared — first-letter blocking, cost recall . Comparison. Categorical fields (gender, suffix, salutation) use exact match; middle name uses Jaro–Winkler. surname first name use dedicated comparators: Surname (compare_two_names()): max whole-string match (robust separator noise: MCLANE ↔︎ MC-LANE) coverage token-match divided smaller token count (robust dropped/added/reordered token: ANDREWS-MCLANE ↔︎ MCLANE). Accepted links closed connected components hard invariant: person cluster holds one record per organization-year. Links added strongest-first; link fuse two records org-year rejected counted. cluster gets one deterministic EMP_ID (content hash sorted members), id stable across runs long membership .

OFFICER, CEO/CFO/COO/...), executive director, general manager, general counsel, comptroller. management officers, distinct volunteer governance officers . STAFF paid employees – functional directors (DIRECTOR ..., MEDICAL DIRECTOR), functional vice presidents (VICE PRESIDENT ...), managers, coordinators, administrators, clerks, generic employees. Anything matched – role-specific organization- specific titles (e.g. CHAPLAIN, SERGEANT ARMS, HISTORIAN, CONSULTANT, MILITARY).
